title: G10: Compiled-language lesson harness (L)
description:
A lesson harness that compiles student C with the runner and checks results in lessons.
Acceptance:
- Given a C lesson, the harness compiles, runs and checks expected output or registers.
- npm run lesson -- check runs the reference solution through it.
- Compile errors reach the student in STE.
right_now_summary: The team is building a harness to compile, run, and check C lesson solutions.
